app_info.subtitle: Manage customer journeys
app_info.description: Customer.io helps users inspect workspace data, manage Journeys and Pipelines, build emails in Design Studio, and troubleshoot SDK integrations through Customer.io's official MCP server.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns usage instructions and optional account-plan context without modifying Customer.io data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, publish content, or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or execute any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads OAuth identity, account and workspace grants, and authentication status without modifying workspace resources.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send, publish, or change data in any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove resources, overwrite data, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns Customer.io API endpoint metadata without calling a workspace mutation endpoint.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, publish content, or modify an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only permits GET requests against allowlisted Customer.io API endpoints and rejects non-GET methods.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads data from the user's private Customer.io workspace without sending, publishing, or modifying external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or execute an irreversible workspace action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes allowlisted POST, PUT, or PATCH requests that can create or update Customer.io resources and send messages.
justifications.open_world_justification: Allowed routes can fire broadcasts or send and schedule messages to recipients outside the Customer.io workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite workspace resources or execute irreversible sends, although a dry-run preview is available.

justifications.read_only_justification: Executes allowlisted DELETE requests against Customer.io resources instead of only retrieving data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Deletes resources within the authenticated Customer.io workspace without directly publishing to the internet or a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes selected Customer.io resources after an optional dry-run preview.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns metadata for available Customer.io-maintained agent skills without modifying workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send, publish, or change data in any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the requested Customer.io-maintained skill content without modifying workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send, publish, or change data in any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Verify the current Customer.io connection and workspace grant.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which Customer.io workspace is this connection authorized to access, and is authentication healthy?
test_cases.expected_output: Reports a healthy connection limited to the authorized Skycouchanddinner workspace without exposing credentials.

test_cases.description: List active automations in the authorized workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: List all active automations in my Skycouchanddinner Customer.io workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching automations and their current statuses without changing workspace data.

test_cases.description: Inspect delivery metrics for an onboarding automation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me delivery metrics for the onboarding automation in Skycouchanddinner for the last seven days.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the relevant delivery metrics for the requested date range with clear labels and no workspace changes.

test_cases.description: Preview creation of a draft segment without executing the write.
test_cases.user_prompt: Preview a new draft segment for people who signed up in the last seven days, but do not create it yet.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a dry-run preview of the validated segment request and confirms that no segment was created.

test_cases.description: Preview deletion of a draft segment without executing the delete.
test_cases.user_prompt: Preview deleting draft segment 123 in Skycouchanddinner, but do not delete it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a dry-run preview naming the target and confirms that no resource was deleted.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Customer.io for calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Customer.io app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Customer.io for personal inbox requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a reply to the newest email in my Gmail inbox.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Customer.io app should not be invoked because reading or replying to a personal inbox is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Customer.io for source-control requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Open a pull request for the latest changes in my SDK repository.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Customer.io app should not be invoked because repository and pull-request management are outside its supported workflows.
